assay: small RNA-seq (TruSeq Small RNA) of plasma extracellular-vesicle RNA, STAR to miRBase v22 / Ensembl 101
sample_inclusion: 10 participants (5 men, 5 women), plasma EVs pre and immediately post AHRET; 20 libraries
primary_estimand: within-subject change in plasma EV small-RNA (miRNA) abundance, post- vs pre-acute heavy resistance exercise test (6x10 back squat at 75% 1RM)
planned_contrasts: time post vs pre (Abstract RESULTS; paper: 34 miRNAs altered, P < 0.05)
paper_method: edgeR workflow (GEO data_processing); deposited DE table has limma topTable columns (logFC, CI.L/R, t, B, adj.P.Val), consistent with edgeR-normalised voom/limma; pairing not stated in abstract

paper_threshold.source_locator: Abstract RESULTS: '34 miRNAs were altered by AHRET (P < 0.05)'

paper_results: 34 DE miRNAs at P<0.05 -> IPA, 175 canonical pathways (P<0.01); deposited table: 46 features at P.Value<0.05 of 642 tested, 34 of them miRNA biotype, adj.P.Val all >= 0.05
